files.text:
# Product document for `us-refine-fix-records-phrase`.
#
# The catalogue phrases every step of the Story doc-outline but AC-2's
# last; the fix adds the entry that phrases "Claude offers to summarise
# the document instead".

title: "MCP Google Docs Editor (BDD fixture stub)"
summary: "Synthetic product document for BDD fixtures — deliberately minimal."

roles:
  - name: Claude User
    definition: "An individual who uses Claude Desktop or Claude Web App and wants to work on their Google Docs through natural language commands"
    primary_use_case: "Document reading and editing through a conversational AI interface"
    characteristics:
      - "Non-technical users focused on content creation and editing"

vocabulary:
  forbidden_qualifiers:
    - properly
    - correctly
    - appropriate
    - user-friendly
    - fast
  forbidden_actions:
    - name: "handle"
      reason: "Hides what the system observably does with the input."
      replacement: "Name the observable action: displays, returns, lists, rejects."

glossary:
  - term: Google Doc
    means: >-
      A document in the Claude User's Google Drive, the thing every
      request names.
  - term: outline
    means: >-
      The document's headings, in document order, as Claude lists them
      in the conversation.

catalogue:
  - template: 'a Google Doc with {count:number} heading[s] is shared with the {actor:role}'
    block: given
    means: A Google Doc holding that many headings is shared with that role's account; "no" means none.
    terms: [Google Doc]
  - template: 'a Google Doc that is not shared with the {actor:role}'
    block: given
    means: A Google Doc exists that that role's account cannot open.
    terms: [Google Doc]
  - template: 'the {actor:role} asks Claude to outline the document'
    block: when
    means: That role asks Claude, in the conversation, for the outline of the Google Doc.
    terms: [Google Doc, outline]
  - template: 'Claude displays an outline of {count:number} heading[s]'
    block: then
    means: Claude's reply lists exactly that many headings, in document order.
    terms: [outline]
  - template: 'Claude displays the message "{message}"'
    block: then
    means: Claude's reply in the conversation is exactly the quoted message.
    terms: []
  - template: 'Claude offers to summarise the document instead'
    block: then
    means: Claude's reply contains an offer to produce a summary of the Google Doc, which the Claude User can accept in the next turn; the offer's exact wording is not fixed.
    terms: [Google Doc]

story:
    id: doc-outline
    title: Document Outline On Demand
    as_a: Claude User
    i_want: Claude to list the headings of a shared Google Doc when I ask for its outline
    so_that: I can see how the document is organised before I read it
    status: PLANNED
    acceptance_criteria:
        - id: AC-1
          description: Claude must display every heading of a shared Google Doc, in document order, when the Claude User asks for its outline.
          steps:
            - given:
                - a Google Doc with 3 headings is shared with the Claude User
            - when:
                - the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document
            - then:
                - Claude displays an outline of 3 headings
        - id: AC-2
          description: Claude must display the message "This document has no headings" and offer a summary instead when the Claude User asks for the outline of a document without headings.
          steps:
            - given:
                - a Google Doc with no headings is shared with the Claude User
            - when:
                - the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document
            - then:
                - Claude displays the message "This document has no headings"
                - and: Claude offers to summarise the document instead
        - id: AC-3
          description: Claude must display the message "This document is not shared with your account" when the Claude User asks for the outline of a document they cannot open.
          steps:
            - given:
                - a Google Doc that is not shared with the Claude User
            - when:
                - the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document
            - then:
                - Claude displays the message "This document is not shared with your account"
